announcements.headline: Societe Generale: shares and voting rights as of 31 October 2026
announcements.insight: Societe Generale updates its shares and voting rights as of 31 October 2026. This follows earlier announcements regarding a new employee share ownership programme launched in May.

announcements.headline: Societe Generale: Combined General Meeting and Board of Directors dated 27 May 2026
announcements.insight: The board convened a combined general meeting following the May employee share programme launch to likely approve related governance matters.

announcements.headline: Societe Generale launches a new global employee share ownership programme
announcements.insight: Societe Generale launches a new global employee share ownership programme. This aligns staff interests with shareholders but lacks financial detail.
